property_summary: For any funded actor and any timestamp greater than zero, the very first call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether must succeed (since pastBlockTime starts at 0 and block.timestamp > 0); the mutant's inverted guard block.timestamp < 0 is unsatisfiable, so it reverts for every such input.
change_summary: Invert the time guard to `require(block.timestamp < pastBlockTime);` so subsequent calls revert and `pastBlockTime` is never updated after the first state in which it holds a nonzero value.
